 About the match
 On this page you can find the Avispa Fukuoka vs Gamba Osaka match lineup for J1 League — Round 11 - First Leg, on Wednesday 21-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Avispa Fukuoka lines up in a 3-4-2-1 led by Kamijima, while Gamba Osaka sets up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Nakatani. Avispa Fukuoka is led by head coach Shinya Tsukahara, while Gamba Osaka is managed by Tomokazu Myojin. The match is played at Best Denki Stadium.
